exercise1.prompt: The shape of the question decides the shape of the picture.

hiddenCases.name: each bar is its own team's mean

exercise1.hint: A bar chart of "mean by team" is a group-by with the means rounded for display. Get that table right and the chart is one more line.

questions.prompt: Match each question to the chart that answers it.
questions.explain: Choosing the chart is choosing the question. A bar chart of a time series is the most common mismatch, and it hides the trend it was meant to show.

questions.prompt: Why does this unit grade the summary rather than the picture?
choices: A chart can only be as honest as the table behind it
questions.explain: A beautiful chart of a wrong group-by is a wrong chart. The table is where the mistakes are, and where they are findable.

questions.prompt: What is wrong with a bar chart of daily visits over a year?
choices: Bars are for categories -- 365 of them hide the trend a line would show
questions.explain: Time is continuous and ordered. A line says that; hundreds of bars say "these are unrelated categories".
